title: Rabbits And Foxes
description: Interactive simulation for Rabbits And Foxes
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Rabbits
learningObjectives: Identify the predator and prey roles that drive a fox-and-rabbit population model
Predict how raising the initial fox count while holding the rabbit count fixed accelerates the decline of the rabbit population
Explain how agent-based rules for movement and capture produce population change without any explicit differential equation
Compare the random-motion version with the straight-line-motion version to see how prey movement strategy affects capture rate
Trace the collision-detection step that removes a rabbit and grows a fox on each frame of the simulation loop
